scheme_name: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana
description:
The Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana is a significant welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched on 1st January 2021. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to the children of domestic workers and laborers. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure that children from economically weaker sections receive proper education. 

The scheme specifically targets children of female domestic workers and laborers. 

The government has set a measurable target to provide scholarships to at least 50,000 children annually under this scheme. 

The scholarship amount provided under this scheme is ₹10,000 per year for each eligible child. 

This financial assistance is aimed at covering educational expenses such as tuition fees, books, and other necessary materials. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the dropout rate among children of laborers and domestic workers. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are clearly defined. 

Applicants must be children of registered domestic workers or laborers. 

The age limit for applicants is between 6 to 18 years. 

Families must have an annual income of less than ₹3 lakh to qualify for the scholarship. 

The scheme is applicable to children studying in recognized schools or educational institutions. 

To apply for the scholarship, the following documents are required. 

Applicants must provide proof of identity such as an Aadhar card or voter ID. 

They must also submit proof of their parent's employment as a domestic worker or laborer. 

Income certificates from the relevant authorities must be included in the application. 

Additionally, a bonafide certificate from the educational institution is required. 

The application process involves several steps. 

First, applicants must visit the official website of the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

They need to download the application form available on the website. 

After filling out the form, applicants must attach all required documents. 

The completed application form must be submitted to the nearest Labour Department office. 

Applications can also be submitted online through the official portal. 

The timeline for application submission is from 1st January to 31st March every year. 

The disbursement of the scholarship amount occurs in the month of April. 

Once the applications are processed, eligible candidates will receive the scholarship amount directly in their bank accounts. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Labour and Employment. 

State Labour Departments are responsible for the execution of the scheme at the state level. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Ministry of Labour and Employment at their helpline number 1800 425 1515. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to empower women and promote education among underprivileged sections of society. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the socio-economic conditions of laborers and domestic workers. 

The scheme also aims to create awareness about the importance of education among these communities. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹500 crore for the implementation of this scheme over the next five years. 

This financial commitment demonstrates the government's dedication to supporting the education of children from marginalized backgrounds. 

The scheme is expected to benefit a significant number of families across the country. 

It is particularly focused on urban areas where domestic work is prevalent. 

The initiative is also aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations. 

By promoting education, the scheme aims to contribute to Goal 4, which is to ensure inclusive and equitable quality education. 

The government has also planned awareness campaigns to reach out to potential beneficiaries. 

These campaigns will be conducted in collaboration with local NGOs and community organizations. 

The scheme is expected to have a positive impact on the overall literacy rate among children of laborers. 

It aims to empower these children to pursue higher education and better career opportunities in the future. 

The scholarship amount of ₹10,000 is significant in covering the basic educational needs of a child. 

The scheme is a step towards breaking the cycle of poverty among laborer families. 

It encourages parents to prioritize their children's education. 

The government is continuously monitoring the implementation of the scheme to ensure transparency and efficiency. 

Regular audits and evaluations are conducted to assess the impact of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is also taken into account for future improvements. 

The Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana is a crucial initiative for social upliftment. 

It aims to create a more equitable society by providing educational opportunities to the underprivileged. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's efforts in promoting social justice and equality. 

By focusing on education, the scheme not only benefits individual families but also contributes to national development. 

The government encourages eligible families to take advantage of this scheme. 

It is essential for families to be aware of the benefits available to them. 

The scheme represents a significant investment in the future of India's children. 

It is a proactive approach to addressing the challenges faced by laborer families in accessing quality education. 

The Theka Shramik scheme is a beacon of hope for many families striving for a better future. 

It embodies the spirit of empowerment and progress in the face of adversity. 

The government remains committed to expanding and enhancing this scheme in the coming years. 

This initiative is a vital part of India's broader strategy to improve education and reduce inequality. 

The Theka Shramik scheme is a crucial step towards achieving a more educated and prosperous society.
